description: Find insiders (people and organisations whose trades are disclosed in SEC Form 4: CEOs, officers, directors, 10%+ owners including funds) by name, ticker or type, or list them most active first. Step 1 of a copy/inverse insider model ('make a model that copies Bezos'): search the name, pick the right result from its companies, roles and activity, then call get_insider_trades with its slug. Search is loose: any order and case, word starts, initials, nicknames both ways (bill = william), typos, run-together or split names (jeffbezos, value act), legal suffixes ignored, and extra words tolerated (half the words must match; full matches rank first, matched_words says how many matched). Several people can share a name: check companies and roles. Curated aliases cover famous names filed differently (Jensen Huang files as 'Huang Jen Hsun'). Each result has lag_days_median/_p90 (days from trade to public disclosure) and late_filing_share.

active_since.description: YYYY-MM-DD: last disclosure on or after this date.

q.description: Name to search, e.g. "jeff bezos" or "pershing square". Omit to list.

role.description: Role ever held at any company.

ticker.description: Only insiders who filed at this company, e.g. "AMZN".

name: get_insiders

data.description: The TickerDB API response payload for this tool call.
